name: Pendant
author: Erin Carter
description: A hanging mobile turns in lamplight and the wall sees only its shadow — discs, a crescent, a slim bar — suspended at staggered heights from hairline threads. Each piece revolves about its thread axis so its projected shadow widens to a disc and thins to a bar; pieces hang at different distances so the top shapes hover blurry while the lowest nearly bites. The wall glow blends warm hues, penumbrae fringe cool, and the hot spot flares around each silhouette. Bodies emit nothing; the motion is read entirely in negative.

params.label: Turn speed
params.effect: How fast the pieces revolve about their hanging threads, driving the disc-to-bar morphs.

params.label: Piece size
params.effect: CSS-pixel diameter of the mobile's shapes.

params.label: Penumbra
params.effect: Scales the per-piece blur tiers, from a uniformly crisp mobile at 0 to the upper shapes dissolving at 2.

params.label: Sway
params.effect: Amplitude of the shared pendular drift of the whole mobile across the wall.
